title: Minimal Monitor Architecture for 99.9% Catch Rate

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping current monitor architectures to a concrete precision-recall target forces the field to confront the gap between current capability and deployment needs. The benchmark itself is a reusable contribution.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating a labeled dataset of 1,000 agent action traces is the main challenge. If traces are synthetically generated, this is feasible. Evaluating monitors on the benchmark is straightforward. Moderate complexity overall.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two tasks: create the benchmark dataset AND evaluate multiple monitor architectures. Dataset creation alone could be 30 hours. Feasible if using existing traces or a synthetic generation shortcut, but as stated, scope is tight.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
